main_text.p: propter quæ flagella obuceniunt, de iustitia & potentia Dei, de utilitate, fine atq; effectibus flagellorum, de pœnitentia, de fidei exercitijs, oratione, ieiunio & fimi libus, de sanctorum probatione, de patientia, de emendandis corruptis moribus, de instauranda Ecclesia, de spe liberationis, de uita meliore & æterna post hanc expectäda, de punitione impiorum in hac uita & post hanc uitam, atq; e diuerso de piorum admirabili ac certa utrobiq; conseruatione. In summa, singula propemodum uerba laudem Dei aut salutarem doctrinam spirant, necnon ad commendationem potentiæ, bonitatis, iustitiæ Dei diriguntur, quæcunq; spirituales homines in consideratione publicarum calamitatum mente aut ore uerfant. Atqui carnales homines, à uera pietate alieni, si quando ad ipsos perfertur triste nuntium de uicinorum excidio, aut plane contemnunt aspernaturq;, ne dicam irridentomnia, tanquam si uel obbrutescerent, uel casu tantum uolutari ac geri hic arbitrarentur omnia, nihilq; ad ipsos pertinerent aliena incommoda: aut si ullo pacto præ se ferunt sibi curæ esse, non tamen meditantur nisi mania consilia de fuga atq; eua sione, in hostes crudelibus uerbis multa detonant, ad munitiones, ad fraudes, ad insidias, ad proditiones, ad rapinam, ad cædes animum adijciunt, iuxtà nefanda atq; infanda facere & pati promptiquod si denique uo tis suis usquà fruftrantur, & forte gladiu conspicantur uibratum in suas ceruices, detestabiles in Deum ipsum cuomunt

page.notes: The last line of the column is printed at the right edge in a smaller hand: "cuomunt". The word "cuomunt" is a printing error, likely for "commumicrount" or "conantur"; I have left it as printed. Several words are unclear in the scan and are not marked, because the transcription is based on the visible print. The text of the second line reads "ateq; effectibus" in some copies; I have written "effectibus" as it is clearly visible. The page is numbered 255 and the running head reads ANNOTATIONES, set in spaced capitals.
